# _generated — DO NOT EDIT

This package is the **typed transport layer** for the Aplos NCA SaaS SDK. It is
generated by [`openapi-python-client`](https://github.com/openapi-generators/openapi-python-client)
from the v3 OpenAPI spec and is **fully overwritten** on every regeneration.

Do not hand-edit anything in this directory. To change it:

1. Refresh `openapi/openapi-spec.json` from the IaC repo's generated spec.
2. Run `./openapi/generate-client.sh`.

The public, hand-written ergonomic facade (`AplosClient`) and the existing
`nca_resources` helpers live **outside** this package and wrap it. See
`Aplos-NCA-Architecture/tickets/NE-1613/NE-1849-codegen-design.md`.

Contents:
- `client.py` — `Client` / `AuthenticatedClient` (httpx-based)
- `models/` — typed `attrs` models (User, Tenant, Execution, File, …)
- `api/<tag>/<operationId>.py` — one typed function per API operation
